scope: HPO survey: implicit differentiation of exact ridge solution and grid/random/Sobol controls; 19 vs 20 linear solves are disclosed. OmniOpt is a taxonomy/survey, so norm-LMO mechanisms are demonstrated rather than inventing a single OmniOpt optimizer. ASHA-related stopping policy uses real four-worker training segments, completion-only validation observations and checkpoint continuation. Warm-start rule continues until three rung results exist; this explicit variant is not the paper 500-worker system or promotion queue. Timings include scheduler/worker overhead on shared cloud CPU.

environment.scope: Shared cloud CPU; not student laptop; one BLAS thread.
